arch_specific_issues: Dockerfile uses open-liberty:full-java17-openj9 which may lack s390x tags
Dockerfile-daily uses openliberty/daily:full-java17-openj9-ubi - verify s390x availability
Dockerfile-qn uses quay.io/quarkus/ubi-quarkus-graalvmce-builder-image:22.3-java17 - GraalVM CE native-image not available for s390x
Dockerfile-qn runtime quay.io/quarkus/quarkus-micro-image:2.0 may lack s390x support
Dockerfile-wf uses quay.io/wildfly/wildfly:latest-jdk17 - verify s390x availability
Dockerfile-pm uses payara/micro - verify s390x availability
docker-compose uses mongo:latest which supports s390x
Quarkus native build (-Pnative) in pom.quarkus.xml will fail on s390x without GraalVM s390x support or Mandrel
No JNI or arch-specific code in Java sources - pure Java WAR is portable
porting_steps: Replace base image in Dockerfile with s390x-compatible Open Liberty image (e.g. icr.io/appcafe/open-liberty:full-java17-openj9-ubi-minimal)
Build WAR with Maven (./mvnw package) - pure Java, no arch-specific code
For Quarkus variant (Dockerfile-qn), use JVM mode instead of native mode since GraalVM CE lacks s390x support, or use Mandrel for s390x native builds
For Quarkus JVM variant (Dockerfile-qu), replace maven:3-openjdk-17 builder with a multi-arch equivalent and ubi8/ubi-minimal runtime (already s390x compatible)
For WildFly variant (Dockerfile-wf), use quay.io/wildfly/wildfly with verified s390x tag or build from UBI base
Skip Payara variant (Dockerfile-pm) or find s390x-compatible Payara image
Verify mongo:latest pulls s390x manifest in docker-compose
Test with: docker build --platform linux/s390x -f Dockerfile -t acmeair-main:s390x .
